title: Canonical representative (Simon 3.12–3.13) and the support representation 4.10(1)
statement: Assume ApproxTangentAE and (GF). Then CanonicalRepresentative holds (for V stationary in open U: (M_V, Θ) with M_V = {x ∈ U : Θ(x) > 0} is an admissible pair with pairWeight n M_V Θ = μ_V⌞U; {x ∈ M_V : Θ(x) ≥ α} is relatively closed in U for α > 0; and if θ ≥ α > 0 μ_V-a.e. in U then M_V = spt V ∩ U and Θ ≥ α on M_V), and LpSupportRepresentation holds (for V with mean curvature H ∈ L^p_loc in open U, p > n, θ ≥ 1 μ_V-a.e. in U: Θ ≥ 1 on spt V ∩ U, (spt V ∩ U, Θ) is an admissible pair, and its weight is μ_V⌞U).
lean_statement: ApproxTangentAE → (∀ (n ℓ : ℕ) (V : RectifiableVarifold n ℓ), 0 < n → IsFiniteMeasureOnCompacts V.weight ∧ (∀ᵐ x ∂V.weight, Module.finrank ℝ (V.tangentSpace x) = n) ∧ AEStronglyMeasurable (fun x ↦ (V.tangentSpace x).starProjection) V.weight) → CanonicalRepresentative ∧ LpSupportRepresentation
